        <h2>Inside this chapter</h2>
        <p class="section-lede">
          Limited introductions with a plain-language reason they may be worth your attention. Intent, location, Taste and reciprocal eligibility can inform who you see. We will not display a compatibility percentage.
        </p>

            <h3>Fewer introductions on purpose</h3>
            <p>
              In the pilot you get a small set of thoughtful intros. Scarcity protects attention .. so you
              actually read someone, instead of training your brain to discard faces in under a second.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

            <p>
              Every introduction comes with plain-language context .. pace, intent, distance, shared interests.
              No fake percentage. No mystery algorithm flex. Just enough signal to start well.
            </p>
